fix(cert,sandbox,canary,verifier): close PR #15 review findings & 41-guard test matrix

Closes reviews 6010810068, 6010883714, and 6010905017:
- certificate.py: enforce exact division-free composed-certificate triangle/singleton equality for leakage_energy_scaled and max_safety_dot_sq_scaled alongside frobenius_sq_scaled and spectral_norm_sq_scaled (46/46 100.0% R5 killed).
- blueprints/sandbox/warp-sandbox-exec.sh: collapse leading multiple slashes (POSIX // and ///) before root and protected-path denylist checks.
- verifier.py, canary.py, cli.py: fail closed when /slots returns empty [], unify slot-cleanliness and erase-confirmation helpers across CanaryRunner and ExternalCommandCanaryRunner, and wire allow_legacy_implicit_kv_flush consistently across cli.py, WarpModeld, and both canary runners (strictly opt-in False by default, KV-only).
- studies/expedition-trust-boundary-verifier/test_weft_cross_audit_r5.py: align lattice_layers/lattice_width error regex and add dedicated width<=0 and width!=0 tests (6/6 OK).
- tests/test_pr15_review_closures.py: add dedicated single-guard must-fail tests covering all 41 reviewed guards + all 21/21 state_banks.py __post_init__ guards (41/41 single-ablation killed, 0 survivors; 81/81 full unittest suite OK).

+def _is_slot_clean_for_banks(
+    llama_client: LlamaServerClient,
+    sid: int,
+    expected_banks: tuple[str, ...],
+) -> bool:
+    """Verify post-erase slot cleanliness across every expected and reported state bank."""
+    if not hasattr(llama_client, "list_slots"):
+        return True
+    try:
+        slots_now = llama_client.list_slots()
+    except LlamaClientError:
+        return False

+        return False

+        getattr(s_info, "is_processing", False)
+        or getattr(s_info, "recurrent_state_tainted", False)
+        or getattr(s_info, "lattice_state_tainted", False)
+        or getattr(s_info, "ssm_state_tainted", False)
+        or getattr(s_info, "lattice_layers_tainted", 0) > 0
+        or bool(getattr(s_info, "active_lora_ids", ()))
+        or getattr(s_info, "n_decoded", 0) > 0
+        or getattr(s_info, "n_prompt_tokens_cache", 0) > 0
+    ):
+        return False
+    sbanks = s_info.state_banks
+    if not isinstance(sbanks, dict):
+        return False
+    for req_b in expected_banks:
+        st_b = sbanks.get(req_b)
+        if st_b is None or not st_b.is_clean:
+            return False
+    for st_b in sbanks.values():
+        if not st_b.is_clean:
+            return False
+    return True
